title: Shooting Melodies of Barking Dogs
subtitle: at Ludwigsburger Hundefreunde e. V.
content: In summer 2023, we spent five days at the clubhouse of Ludwigsburger Hundefreunde shooting 'Melodies of Barking Dogs' with Elias Maria Burckhardt, Valentin Oppermann, Mieke Schymura, Mikke Rasch, Tristán López and Zlatin Stoychev. Production designer Martha Brenner completely redesigned elements of the wood-paneled room and developed a visual concept together with cinematographer Kim Hausner, based on the idea of shooting the film on the Arri Amira's S16 mode.
